name: Azel
message: 「Good... With this, destroying the magic circle should be easy.」

name: Azel
message: 「The amplification and acceleration of Re-Crea have been halted.」

name: Azel
message: 「However, this power... its momentum won't stop at just that...」

name: Azel
message: 「The time of the decisive battle is near... Shatter my convictions, and then...」

name: Azel
message: 「Protect the Human World... no, the entire world...」
